description:
🚀 NileX Team

We are a team passionate about space exploration, science, and creativity. Our goal is to bring the forgotten stories of NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars to life through research, storytelling, and innovative ideas.

We are looking for creative and motivated teammates interested in astronomy, research, writing, graphic design, programming, animation, or video editing.

No need to be an expert—just bring your curiosity, passion, and willingness to learn!
